issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning a String, but the reference solution implements getTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type int. The problem text even tells students to "Check the expected return type in the UML diagram," which would lead students to implement a String-returning method and cause mismatches with the solution/tests that expect an int.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent. Either update the UML in the problem statement to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (recommended) and adjust the problem text so students implement an int-returning method, or change the solution and tests to return a String and document the required String format. The simplest fix: change the UML line to '+getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int' and remove or adjust the hint that points students to the UML if it remains inaccurate.
